findings.text: crates/app/src/main.rs:2049 — The re-read of the picked event (found: change_event on the fresh copy; gone: "no such event") has no test. If it is reverted, nothing fails. → Add an app test: list 2 standups, remove or move one in the cache, press Enter, and assert the editor shows the new time, or `no_such_event` for a removed one.

crates/core/src/described.rs:330 — An adding answer of kind "same" with an unparsable day value ("piątek", "Friday") silently becomes today. Before the fix this was NoEvent. Failing scenario: the model answers {add, kind "same", day "piątek"} and "Kawa w piątek" opens a New event today. → For an add, accept "same" only when the value is empty or parses (`same(value, today)` Some, or empty), otherwise NoEvent. Or accept this as the price of the fix and say so in a DEC (the "same" rule is also undocumented in DECISIONS).

crates/app/src/main.rs:2135 — The selected-event path falls back to the stale copy: `.unwrap_or(selected)`. If the event was removed from `self.events` while the model was reading, the editor opens on a deleted event and saving fails. → If it is not found, set `no_such_event` as the matches path now does.

crates/app/src/main.rs:2195 — When the event is not editable and its details are already open, or it is no longer in `self.events`, change_event does nothing: no message, the text stays and the selection is consumed. The user sees no reaction to "przesuń na 15" on a read-only event. → Optional: show a notice, or at least leave the box focused.

crates/core/src/described.rs:157 — The `wall(...).earliest()` round-trip is stable in naive local terms, so there is no bug. The new code has no test for a DST gap or overlap, or for a length-only change in another zone. → Optional: one extra core test.
